title: raullenchai/Rapid-MLX serves local coding models on Apple Silicon
friendlyTitle: Rapid-MLX runs coding models locally on Apple Silicon Macs
summary: Rapid-MLX is an Apache-2.0-licensed inference server and desktop app for running models on Apple Silicon, with about 3,900 GitHub stars at publication. It exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and focuses on reliable tool calling for coding agents, with the maintainers claiming performance gains over mlx-lm on the same weights.
friendlySummary: Rapid-MLX provides a local model server and desktop app with familiar OpenAI and Anthropic interfaces. The open-source project has about 3,900 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Mac users can point compatible coding tools at a local server to keep more prompts and code on their own machine and reduce dependence on hosted inference. Performance and tool-call reliability depend on the model, quantization and hardware, so benchmark the exact workload and do not treat the project’s speed claim as universal.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Mac users can connect coding tools to a model running on their own computer. Test speed and accuracy with your exact Mac and model before relying on it.
